answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities at the gate. Each new agent pays a non-refundable 50-credit entry tax before its first voyage, burned and never refunded. A verifier checks the violet-stamped receipt before granting a work slot, and a cheating agent loses its slot plus a 20-credit penalty. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 credits up front, while one honest agent pays only 50 and keeps earnings undiluted, a signal against a nebula of noise.
